# coefficients.json holds the thermodynamics for NB_GRAINS = 8 Voronoi grains, generated by
# ../test1/generate_coefficients.py -ng 8 --kvm 0.04015625 --kgm 0.04015625
# --kvb 0.04015625 --kgb 0.04015625 (Sum-based expressions, N-independent) with the
# parameters of test1 (Table 1 of Aagesen et al. CMS 161 (2019) with the single soft curvature
# k = 2.57e9 J/m3 of Kim et al. 2022). Generate the C++ coefficient classes at configure time.
execute_process(COMMAND python3 ${BUILD_SCRIPT_DIR}/GenerateCoefficient.py -r  -f  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/coefficients.json
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

set(CURRENT_EXE FissionGas3Dtest5)
add_executable(${CURRENT_EXE} main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(${CURRENT_EXE} Sloth)
set_compile_options(${CURRENT_EXE})
add_dependencies(tests ${CURRENT_EXE})

# The 3D Voronoi mesh and the bubble list come from generate_mesh.sh (make_voronoi3d.py + gmsh +
# a finalize step): see README.md in this directory. poly.msh has one physical volume
# "grain_1..8" per grain, a physical surface "box" on the outer faces, and a $Periodic section
# (after $Elements) pairing the opposite box faces in x, y and z; bubbles.txt holds the initial
# bubbles, one "x y z r" line per bubble (nm). The box size is passed to the run with the
# -lx/-ly/-lz defaults.
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/poly.msh ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/poly.msh COPYONLY)
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bubbles.txt ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bubbles.txt COPYONLY)

# Short smoke run: 10 steps of dt=5 (AMR off, the estimator dominates the cost; use -amr for
# production runs). np 4: the 104k-tet Voronoi mesh needs the 4 PRRTE slots; on this 8-core
# machine the run takes ~45 min, so the test is only registered on machines with at least
# 32 logical cores. The specialized time files are appended to, not truncated, so a dirty
# Saves directory would corrupt the comparison.
#
# Compare the bubble-phase inventory (columns 3-4, bit-reproducible) at tight tolerance, and
# the gas inventory + density of the MuGas problem at a looser one: the iterative solves are
# not bit-reproducible across runs (observed ~1e-4 relative in the energy/mu columns), and the
# mu columns are ~0 at early times where a relative criterion is meaningless.
#
# The references in ref/ are the output of exactly the smoke command below, from the committed
# poly.msh ("rm -rf Saves" first: the specialized files are appended to). Register the run and
# its comparisons only when the machine has enough cores AND the references exist; configuring
# otherwise must not fail.
cmake_host_system_information(RESULT NB_CORES QUERY NUMBER_OF_LOGICAL_CORES)
if(NB_CORES GREATER_EQUAL 32
    AND EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ref/op_time_specialized.csv
    AND EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ref/mug_time_specialized.csv)
   add_test(
       NAME FissionGas3Dtest5
       COMMAND bash -c "rm -rf Saves && mpirun -np 4 $<TARGET_FILE:${CURRENT_EXE}> -noamr -t 50 -dtmin 5 -dtmax 5"
   )
   set_tests_properties(FissionGas3Dtest5 PROPERTIES LABELS "3D FISSIONGAS")

   create_col_comparison("CompareFissionGas3Dtest5" "op_time_specialized.csv"
       "Saves/Voronoi/OrderParameters_time_specialized.csv" "3;4" relativeEpsilon 1e-8 FALSE
       "FissionGas3Dtest5" "3D FISSIONGAS")

   create_col_comparison("CompareFissionGas3Dtest5Gas" "mug_time_specialized.csv"
       "Saves/Voronoi/MuGas_time_specialized.csv" "3;5" relativeEpsilon 1e-2 FALSE
       "FissionGas3Dtest5" "3D FISSIONGAS")
else()
   message(STATUS "FissionGas3Dtest5: smoke test skipped (needs >= 32 cores and ref/ present; "
                  "this machine has ${NB_CORES} cores)")
endif()
